name: acore-qr
description: Professional QR code generation platform: a monorepo with web, API, and shared packages.

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm:dev:web" "npm:dev:api"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/contracts -w packages/config -w packages/qr-core -w packages/test-fixtures
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:packages && npm run test:coverage --workspaces --if-present
